mostWorthwhile.text: Making and exporting collagen was the most worthwhile sequence: it connected protein construction inside a cell to support outside it.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the finished fibers to the body felt fairly predictable, though the resulting cross-section clarified that the surface gap remained.

surprise.text: I appreciated that the RNA template remained intact while the collagen chain was made, and that the closed surface still needed deeper remodeling.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless. The signals activating edge cells were a reasonable inference from their descriptions.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the final picture suggests further repair, and the chapter made cellular work relevant to a visible tissue change.
